[IBNATIYYA-FULL:v3p115/r4] IBNATIYYA-FULL, d. 542 · author | holds | The parable warns against being deluded by worldly life, which is exposed to destruction through death or other calamities; mentioning reflective people honors their rank and invites others to compete for it.
